meaning:
κατενώπιον
adv. (= Hom., κατένωπα), [in LXX: Psa.44:15, al. ;]
over against, before: with genitive, τ. δόξης, Ju 24; metaphorically (cf. κατέναντι, and see Lft., Col., l.with), τ. θεοῦ, Eph.1:4, Col.1:22.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
